resolution_notes: base_url: auditor correct — official Codecov API Reference documents versioned REST endpoints under https://api.codecov.io/api/v2 (e.g. /api/v2/{service}/{owner}/repos/{repo}/); host-only https://api.codecov.io is not the API root used by documented paths (https://docs.codecov.com/reference). auth_details: auditor correct — Codecov’s API auth guide and reference use Bearer credentials (Authorization: bearer <access_token> / Bearer token), not Authorization: token; credentials are Codecov access tokens (https://docs.codecov.com/docs/authentication, https://docs.codecov.com/reference).
